name: OpenCode OAuth
description: OAuth device-flow wiring (server, client_id, verification base) for OpenCode providers. Provides the oauth feature only. Install the opencode CLI extension alongside it for the provider type, headers, tools and client signature.
author: aurora
notes: Pairs with the opencode CLI extension for the provider type and client signature.
Review third-party extensions before installing them from a store.

ui.help: Wires device-flow OAuth for OpenCode providers. No headers or tools — combine with the opencode CLI extension.
